workspaces.heading: Why Google Drive?
workspaces.text: Your top workspace is in your Google Drive. Drive keeps your workspaces backed up and reachable from any device, and you can see and share their files like any others. If you chose Documents when the installer asked, your workspaces are on that laptop only.

whyT3Code: The full Claude app needs admin rights to install, which York's laptops don't give you. T3 Code doesn't. It also names your threads for you, saves a version of your work in one click, and keeps gaining features.
privacy: York is on **Claude Enterprise**, under contract with Anthropic. Anthropic's [Commercial Terms](https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms) apply, not its consumer terms.

**Your conversations aren't used for training**, nor is anything the agent reads for you. In Anthropic's words: "By default, we will not use your inputs or outputs from our commercial products (e.g. Claude for Work, Anthropic API, Claude Gov, etc.) to train our models."

**They're deleted within 30 days.** Anthropic deletes them from its back-end storage systems within 30 days, unless its automated trust and safety systems flag one as breaking its [Usage Policy](https://www.anthropic.com/legal/aup). A flagged conversation is kept for up to 2 years.
**Feedback is the exception.** If you send Anthropic feedback, such as with a thumbs up or down on claude.ai, it keeps that whole conversation for up to 5 years and may use it to train its models.

Anthropic's own pages say more: [Is my data used for model training?](https://privacy.claude.com/en/articles/7996868-is-my-data-used-for-model-training) and [How long do you store my organization's data?](https://privacy.claude.com/en/articles/7996866-how-long-do-you-store-my-organization-s-data).

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.what: search and read your email, and write drafts for you to check and send

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.what: see your calendar and, when you ask, add or change events

connectors.name: Asana
connectors.what: see your tasks and, when you ask, create or update them
connectors.note: For Asana: at the top of Asana's page, choose your team's workspace. Unless your team works there, don't choose york.ac.uk. Asana makes that one for everyone with a York email address.

extraTools.question: Would you like the agent to be able to publish and manage Apps Script projects for you?
extraTools.signIn: A browser window will open. Choose your York Google account and allow what clasp asks for. Come back here when the page says "Logged in!".
extraTools.settings: On the Apps Script settings page, check your York account is the one shown at the top right. Then click Google Apps Script API and switch it on. Only you can change this setting.
